units.source_text: “有不少尼姑打这儿路过吧？”岛村问面食店的女人。

en.t: Quite a few nuns pass this way, don't they? Shimamura asked the woman at the noodle shop.
Yes. There is a convent up in these mountains.

units.source_text: 过些时候一下雪，从山里出来，路就不好走了。”

en.t: After a while, once it starts snowing, the road out of the mountains will be hard to travel.
